final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT m.zoneref, s.insurstat, AVG(m.facetresmm / NULLIF(m.geomdeltamm, 0)) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM scanmesh AS m JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = m.zoneref GROUP BY m.zoneref, s.insurstat), step2 AS (SELECT insurstat, AVG(avg_ratio) AS status_avg FROM step1 GROUP BY insurstat), step3 AS (SELECT a.zoneref, a.insurstat, a.avg_ratio, a.record_count, a.avg_ratio - b.status_avg AS difference FROM step1 AS a JOIN step2 AS b ON a.insurstat = b.insurstat WHERE a.avg_ratio > b.status_avg) SELECT insurstat, AVG(avg_ratio) AS avg_group_ratio, COUNT(*) AS record_count, AVG(difference) AS avg_difference FROM step3 GROUP BY insurstat
